voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In the early two-thousands, a Dutch nurse named Lucia de Berk was convicted of murder.
The prosecution's statistic: one in three hundred forty-two million. The chance, they said, that the ward deaths during her shifts were coincidence.
A philosopher of science checked the arithmetic. The same data, calculated correctly.
Seven years into a life sentence, she was acquitted. Only the arithmetic had changed.
